sections_en.text: This document sets out the inspection steps every five years for CO2 fire extinguishers; these extinguishers are used for fire fighting in enclosed places by expelling oxygen.

The first draft was prepared and tested by Eng. Hosny Hassan Hussein, reviewed by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater, and approved by Eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Meleigy, General Manager of El-Shabab Gas Power Station

Approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at East Delta Electricity Production Company and the company coordinator for the Maintenance Procedure Information System, and certified by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Soliman, General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company

rows: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Fence off the area to mark the work area and place warning signs
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 00 etc.)
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 000 etc.
Tool bag consisting of a wrench set (open-end, ring) and assorted screwdrivers.
Body test set, dryer
Collect the cylinders at the equipment body test set0
Fill the cylinders with water using the water pump of the set
Move the test valve to the Test position and open the test water source and the main air source.
Operate the body test set to start the test for 5 extinguishers in one batch up to a pressure of 250 bar
Leave the cylinder under this pressure for 5 minutes; after the test succeeds, release the pressure by moving the test valve to the Release position
Remove the carbon dioxide cylinders, empty them of water and dry them well with a special dryer0
Refill the powder cylinders with new ones and check that their pressure has become ideal0
Seal the valves of the cylinders0
Inspect the extinguisher hoses and check that there are no cracks in them0
Check the cleanliness of the nozzle of the hose0
Check that the hose coupling is firmly fixed0
Check that the extinguisher chassis and the wheels of the set are sound0
The extinguisher is scraped and painted when needed.
Check the cleanliness of the fire extinguishing set0
Affix the sticker with the test date

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedure Information System
Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Fire Fighting Systems | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: FS-037-r0a | Equipment: Carbon dioxide fire extinguishers
Issued to: East Delta Electricity Production Company
Status: Approved
Approval date: 07 March 2006 | Procedure: Inspection every five years (P1-Y5)
Next review date: March 2011
Introduction
This document sets out the inspection steps every five years for CO2 fire extinguishers; these extinguishers are used for fire fighting in enclosed places by expelling oxygen.
The first draft was prepared and tested by Eng. Hosny Hassan Hussein, reviewed by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater, and approved by Eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Meleigy, General Manager of El-Shabab Gas Power Station
Approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at East Delta Electricity Production Company and the company coordinator for the Maintenance Procedure Information System, and certified by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Soliman, General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Fence off the area to mark the work area and place warning signs | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 00 etc.) | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 000 etc. | 
Tool bag consisting of a wrench set (open-end, ring) and assorted screwdrivers. | 
Body test set, dryer | 
Work to be Carried Out
Collect the cylinders at the equipment body test set0 | 1.
Fill the cylinders with water using the water pump of the set | 2.
Move the test valve to the Test position and open the test water source and the main air source. | 3.
Operate the body test set to start the test for 5 extinguishers in one batch up to a pressure of 250 bar | 4.
Leave the cylinder under this pressure for 5 minutes; after the test succeeds, release the pressure by moving the test valve to the Release position | 5.
Remove the carbon dioxide cylinders, empty them of water and dry them well with a special dryer0 | 6.
Refill the powder cylinders with new ones and check that their pressure has become ideal0 | 7.
Seal the valves of the cylinders0 | 8.
Inspect the extinguisher hoses and check that there are no cracks in them0 | 9.
Check the cleanliness of the nozzle of the hose0 | 10.
Check that the hose coupling is firmly fixed0 | 11.
Check that the extinguisher chassis and the wheels of the set are sound0 | 12.
The extinguisher is scraped and painted when needed. | 13.
Check the cleanliness of the fire extinguishing set0 | 14.
Affix the sticker with the test date | 15.
